name: Icon field word swap
looks: Small brand or category icon bubbles sit scattered loosely across the frame, drifting gently, behind one bold word set large and centred. The word hard-cuts to a second word naming a sibling category while the icon field holds underneath. Then the icons drift apart to the frame's edges and fade, clearing down to a single small accent dot.
build: Icon bubbles are DOM/SVG chips at seeded positions with a slow idle sine drift. The headline is one DOM block per word, hard-swapped on the beat, no crossfade. On the clearing beat, each bubble tweens to a far edge/corner on power3.in, staggered 20-40ms apart, fading as it leaves; the last element left is one small accent dot, held.
sound: A soft ambient hum under the drift, a hit on each word swap, a whoosh as the icons clear.
prompt: Open on small category icon bubbles scattered and drifting behind one bold centred word, hard-cutting to a second word naming a sibling category. Then let the icons drift apart to the edges and clear away, leaving a single small accent dot on screen.
source: an investing-platform demo film in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/rammanq-f5a90f), studied 2026-10-09
